name: Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B
text:
## Model Description (Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B)
Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B is NVIDIA’s large reasoning-oriented derivative of Meta Llama 3.1, designed to reduce inference cost and latency relative to a model of its scale. Its engineering story centers on architecture and inference efficiency as much as raw benchmark performance.
